description: The file defines the MockSearch class, a test implementation of the SearchEngine class used for search functionality within the SuiteCRM platform. It provides methods to perform mock search operations and display results, primarily used for unit testing purposes.

classes.name: MockSearch
classes.description: A mock implementation of the SearchEngine used for testing search functionalities.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a mock search based on the search string 'bar' and returns a SearchResults object with dummy data.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Outputs the total number of search results from a search query.
